chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 23: Li Huowang's Crisis of Faith and Bai Lingmiao's Kindness
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang hits rock bottom, refusing to leave the cave temple. But Bai Lingmiao's stubborn kindness and a haunting vision of Yang Na force him to choose survival.
og_description: Separated from reality, Li Huowang finds his only anchor in a girl who won't let him give up.
twitter_title: When a Madman Decides to Go On Living
twitter_description: Home is gone. Family might be imaginary. But Li Huowang chooses to survive anyway.
